title: Collection of the Balance on a Vacation Package
content:
The balance standing on a package among the Vacation Package Products is money the party owes on their own booking, and paying it is the party's own act on their own asset: the party pays, and the payment is credited to the package.

## Basis

The balance is worked out only after the package ledger carries a surcharge line answering every surcharge the operator has notified against the package.

Until such a line stands on the package ledger, answering every surcharge notified by the operator against that package, the balance is not worked out.

## What the payment does

One payment puts a single payment line of the amount given onto that package's ledger, in the currency the party is presented with, recorded as the numbered instalment of the payment schedule it settles. The payment posts on the current business date, is credited to the package as a whole rather than to any one traveller, and reduces what is still outstanding on it by that amount. The party sees the payment on the package statement straight away.

## How it is made

The tool `settle_package_balance_32304520` belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## What must be given

| Given | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bundle_package_id` | the internal reference number of the vacation package the money is paid toward, read from the package record returned by the package lookup | an identifier |
| `balance_due_usd` | the amount paid | a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the nearest cent, and never negative |
| `currency_charged` | the currency the party is presented with for this payment; it records presentation only and never converts the amount given | an ISO 4217 currency code, 3 uppercase letters, in upper case and with no spaces |
| `instalment_sequence` | which numbered instalment of the package payment schedule this payment settles | a whole number starting at 1, counted in the order the instalments fall due |

## What comes back

A one-line receipt string. It contains the reference number of the payment line created, a string that begins with the letters bnp and an underscore, the amount paid in US dollars to two decimal places, and the package reference number it was credited to. A string of this shape means the payment is now standing on the package; any other outcome means nothing was taken.
